Targeted 5% MQL lift on Contact Sales form fills
Established parity across sales cycle and customer success touchpoints

Covers Mac, Windows, and Linux download pages
Raises awareness of Slack mobile apps alongside desktop downloads

Strict eligibility: 250+ employees, net new opportunity, decision maker involvement
Enables passive revenue generation through partner channel

title: Slack.com Consent Updates for Forms
tagline: Reusable privacy consent component across all Slack.com forms
description: Developed a reusable consent component to capture user privacy and marketing consent across all forms on Slack.com following the Salesforce acquisition. Built in Hack (frontend and backend) with conditional logic based on country-level privacy requirements (GDPR, Japan-specific rules), piping consent data into Salesforce.
highlights: Covers three consent tiers: no prior consent, marketing consent, and data processing consent (Japan)
Built in Hack with vanilla JavaScript for dynamic field visibility
Pipes consent data into Salesforce for proper routing
First deployed on the Contact Sales form, then reused across all forms

highlights: Replaced external ON24 redirect with a seamless in-page registration form
Integrated ON24 REST API and AddEvent API for calendar event links
Added ability for users to modify their registration after signing up

title: Slack Lists: Files Column
tagline: Introduced the File Column type for Slack Lists
description: Shipped the File Column Type for Slack Lists — allowing users to attach and manage files (images, PDFs, videos, and more) directly within list items across desktop and mobile. Features include multi-file attachment (up to 10), hover previews, lightbox view, recent files menu, and full cross-platform sync.
highlights: Launched to all Pro, Business+, and Enterprise teams by August 14, 2024
Supports up to 10 files per list item across all major file types
Works across desktop, iOS, and Android with consistent sync
Implemented lazy loading for performance and optimized keyboard navigation for accessibility
Used Slack's internal file API for seamless integration

title: Byteboard Skills Report Redesign
tagline: Full redesign of Byteboard's core candidate evaluation artifact
description: Led the complete redesign of Byteboard's Skills Report — the primary artifact clients use to evaluate candidates — from scratch. First major project at Byteboard after joining in February 2022. Updated the design system for the client platform in tandem. Technologies: React, Firebase, TypeScript, MUI.
highlights: Skills Report code hadn't been touched in nearly 4 years
Updated design system and refactored codebase for maintainability
Goals: increased transparency, better candidate behavior highlights, improved readability
Received strong client praise: "The new report scorecard is so much better. Thank you for the work here, it makes my job much easier."
Managed project timeline and milestones using Asana

title: Byteboard Client Platform Candidate Actions
tagline: Self-serve candidate management tooling for Byteboard clients
description: Developed a full self-serve candidate management experience for Byteboard's client platform. Previously, clients had nearly zero visibility or control once an interview was sent — now they can edit deadlines, send reminders, request support, and view a full interview event timeline.
highlights: Seven conditional views based on candidate invitation state
New timeline component tracking all events on a candidate
5+ new user action components (edit deadline, send reminder, request support, etc.)
Reduced manual workload for the GTM team
Shared in Byteboard's Q4 2022 product newsletter

title: Byteboard Pre-Interview Comms & Interview Hub
tagline: Redesigned candidate pre-interview experience to increase motivation and completion rates
description: Developed a complete refresh of the candidate pre-interview experience for Byteboard, including an updated invitation email and a new Interview Hub landing page. Goal: reduce time from invite to submission and increase candidate motivation by setting clear expectations and reducing interview anxiety.
highlights: Updated candidate invitation email to set expectations and reduce uncertainty
New Interview Hub helps candidates see priority steps at a glance
Includes optional pre-interview breathing exercise to reduce anxiety
Shared in Byteboard's Q4 2022 product newsletter

title: Byteboard Zero State Dashboard
tagline: New-client dashboard experience to reduce churn at Byteboard
description: Designed and built a zero state dashboard for Byteboard's client portal to reduce churn by providing immediate value before the first 10 reports are ready. Refactored the dashboard from a 1,000+ line monolithic file into modular, reusable React components. Technologies: React, Redux, TypeScript, MUI.
highlights: Refactored 1,000+ line dashboard into modular components (main page reduced to 200 lines)
Created reusable DashboardCard, DashboardColumn, DashboardFilterBar components
Supports multiple dashboard states beyond zero state
Managed using Asana; designed using Figma with UX designer

title: Techqueria Job Board

highlights: 700+ page views in first 28 days after launch
3,670+ candidates in resume bank by September 2021
Designed job board icons, managed Slack channel integration
Used WP Job Manager plugin with custom enhancements
Airtable resume bank integrated with Slack channel notifications
Generated new passive revenue stream for Techqueria as a nonprofit
